claim_policy: This matrix tracks readiness against the NeurIPS main-track evidence plan. A pass means the current artifact supports that checklist item at the stated scope; partial means useful evidence exists but is too narrow or mixed; fail means current evidence contradicts the strong version of the requirement; blocked means the item cannot be completed without human labels, storage repair/approval, or an external review.
